messages:
Amanda C: Heads up — SG-dc-3 inter-rack link flapping since 03:12 UTC, provisioning jobs failing on dedicated pool apac-sg. Noticing repeated NACKs to the allocator. Vendor KeenLogistics just messaged: their truck delayed at customs, replacement units ETA bumped. Opening thread to align RMA & procurement.

Liam R: @Amanda C can you paste the allocator error? is it causing node drains?

Amanda C: node drains yes, 6 GPUs impacted, jobs stuck in PENDING. error snippet:
```json
[2026-03-23T03:14:07Z] allocator: allocate failed: link_timeout to sg-dc-3.planex:5678, kvstore unreachable
```

Suzanne P: pinging KeenLogistics contact, @KeenLogistics (vendor) — any update on AWB or RMA for the 6 units we flagged last week? PO# 5492.

KeenLogistics (vendor): Sorry — customs hold on airwaybill AWB-GBR-8821, clearance ETA +48h. We can authorize a partial RMA from the FRA pool to SG for 4 units, but will be charged expedite fee USD 1,200 per unit. Need confirmation.

Raj (ops): If we accept 4 from FRA, remaining 2? We need a short-term loaner from local forwarder if possible.

ForwarderBot: Suggested forwarders with next-day: AirShift (rate USD 1,450/unit) or RapidSend (1,250/unit). Requesting quotes...

Amanda C: Cost tradeoff: expedite from FRA (1,200) vs local loaner RapidSend (1,250) — plus transit risk. Prefer FRA if they can drop ship directly to dc and handle customs.

Liam R: Also consider rebalancing from apac-syd pool — we have 2 spare H100 there but cross-region costs + reconfigure time ~3h. That could avoid loaner cost.

Suzanne P: Timeline: FRA -> SG transit 24h + customs; RapidSend next-day 08:00 local. Which meets the SLO? Current latency SLO violations measured on alloc: 30% higher P95.

Raj (ops): Ops contingency: 1) Accept 4 FRA expeds now, vendor to issue proforma & AWB numbers; 2) Move 2 from SYD -> SG as temporary; 3) Create RMA for customs-held batch so we can claim insurance. @Amanda C set a deploy hold on new allocations to SG-dc-3.

Amanda C: done deploy hold, added canary fallback to apac-standby model. Also created ticket INF-2026 to track.

KeenLogistics (vendor): We can do FRA -> SG for 4 units. Need PO amend & expedite approval by finance. AWB once approved: AWB-FRA-3321. We'll also start RMA paperwork for AWB-GBR-8821.

FinanceBot: Expense approval required: expedite fee USD 4,800 + customs broker fee USD 560. Reply with `approve` to route charge.

Suzanne P: @FinanceBot approve

FinanceBot: Charge routed to cost center INF-OPS-APAC. ETA docs sent.

Liam R: Quick note — reconfigure SYD units will require kernel patch for runtime; schedule ~2h, I'll own.

Amanda C: Ok plan confirmed. Action items: 1) Suzanne to get PO amendment, 2) KeenLogistics to ship FRA -> SG and provide AWB, 3) Raj to trigger SYD rebalancing, 4) Liam to patch runtime, 5) Amanda to monitor allocator & remove deploy hold once capacity restored. Tagging follow-ups.

Suzanne P: On it, filing PO amend now.

KeenLogistics (vendor): RMA started for AWB-GBR-8821, RMA# KL-RMA-2147. Will update once customs clears.

Raj (ops): Booking RapidSend loaner as fallback in case FRA hits further delay (holding until 12:00 UTC).

Amanda C: thanks, setting alert to escalate if capacity not restored by 12:00 UTC @here :eyes: 

ForwarderBot: Booking created: RapidSend quote REF-9932 pending confirmation.

Liam R: I'll start patch in 10m, call if I need warm spares.

Suzanne P: PO amendment done, sent to KeenLogistics, invoice terms updated.

KeenLogistics (vendor): AWB-FRA-3321 created, est arrival 2026-03-24T09:00 SGT. Shipping manifest attached (link).

Amanda C: Received — removing deploy hold after FRA units show 'in_transit' and allocator shows capacity +4. Will monitor CRL and KV store.

Raj (ops): Closing loop — once RMA complete file insurance claim for AWB-GBR-8821.

Amanda C: thx all. :thumbsup:
